ogTitle: Image Resizer - Exact Sizes for YouTube, Shorts, Reels and Instagram
ogDescription: Resize a photo with creator presets or exact pixels. Everything runs on your device.
ldDescription: Resize photos for YouTube, Shorts, Reels, Instagram and X with exact dimensions, entirely in the browser.
lede: Resize a photo for YouTube, Shorts, Reels, Instagram or X. Pick a preset or type exact pixels - the image never leaves your browser.

faq.a: YouTube thumbnail 1280x720, Shorts / Reels / TikTok 1080x1920, Instagram square 1080x1080, Instagram portrait 1080x1350 and X post 1200x675. You can also type any size up to 8000 pixels per side.

faq.q: Does the resizer upload my photo?
faq.a: No. The image is decoded and redrawn on a canvas inside your browser. Nothing is sent to a server.
JPG, WebP and PNG. The quality slider applies to JPG and WebP; PNG ignores quality and usually produces a larger file.

related.note: Shrink the resized image before upload
